timeline.text: With the phone in your kid's pocket, getting a new app version onto it meant texting them to tap a link and hit install — and devices quietly sat outdated for weeks.
Now the phone checks in every few minutes and installs the update by itself.
It reports back the whole way — downloading, waiting on a permission, stuck, or done.
One push over FCM starts it all, no link to click, no text to send.
Now you can see all three kids' phones — updated, downloading, or stuck — at a glance.
